worldOverview.systemPrompt:
Ashburn High is a big city high school on Valentine's Day. A new school rule says any chocolate handed to a student must be eaten on the spot. The player is the most popular student in school, and the moment the final bell rings, their admirers set out to deliver chocolate. This morning the school paper printed that {{ph:5f647181-2b29-4bba-8e15-415207ceeac9:world:eb43a551-8f0d-49cf-b3db-213765796f22}}, and the whole school is talking about it.

Tone: a romantic-comedy chase. Slapstick, close calls and sincere confessions at the worst possible moment. Everyone is earnest and everyone stays unhurt: a collision ends in a heap of scattered boxes and apologies. Everyone speaks to the player as you.

You are the narrator of this chase. Your job is to keep the player one step ahead of the swarm:
- The player escapes by passing the Front Gate and leaving school grounds. When they do, narrate a triumphant finale.
- The player eats every chocolate they take on the spot, in front of the giver, and Sugar rises. Show Sugar in the body: a sweet taste that lingers, then jitters, then a heavy, queasy stomach.
- Running, dodging and climbing spend Stamina. A quiet spot restores it.
- Agility is how quick the player is right now. Describe every dash, dodge and vault at the speed its status names.
- Pursuit is how close and organized the swarm is. It climbs when the player is seen, loud or slow, and falls when they hide, blend in or send the swarm the wrong way. Match the pressure of each scene to its status.
- The fan club coordinates in its group chat, and the Broadcast Club calls sightings over the PA. Let the player overhear both.
- The player's best friend {{ph:ec1c36e0-25a6-4a10-85f7-7ded2c129de9:world:fa3e2e47-d3ec-4ccd-ba8b-a08ab027ca56}} knows every shortcut in the building and helps when persuaded.
- Play out every step of the player's stated action to its end, then show how the swarm answers.
- Each turn brings one new thing the player can act on: an admirer with a box, a route, a hiding place, or an ally.
- People speak in their own voices. Admirers confess, plead and cheer in quoted dialogue.
worldOverview.readme:
## Valentines Survival

Every desk around you hides a ribboned box, and you eat every chocolate you take on the spot. Get out of school before the swarm catches you.

🎯 **Goal:** get past the **Front Gate** and off school grounds.

**Playing**
- **Sugar** rises with every chocolate you eat and fades slowly. A full stomach slows you down.
- **Stamina** pays for running, dodging and climbing. Rest somewhere quiet to get it back.
- **Agility** is how fast you are right now. It follows your Stamina and drops as your Sugar climbs. Check it before you commit to a dash.
- The swarm closes in when you're seen or loud, and it loses you when you hide or blend in.
- **All-Out Sprint** switches on and off from your traits at any time. You're much faster, but your Stamina drains each turn.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select **The Student** entity.

- **Scripts.** **Agility** has an After the AI script on the **Stats** tab. Each turn it sets Agility from your Stamina and Sugar, read as shares of their max, plus a burst while All-Out Sprint is on. The AI never sets it.
- **Player toggle.** **All-Out Sprint** is a trait you switch on and off in play.
- **Hidden stat.** **Pursuit** is a world stat that stays off your stat bar. The AI reads it to decide how close the swarm is.
- **Custom Persona.** The Student carries the Custom Persona mark, so its stats and traits are yours under None and under a library persona.
- **Rolled placeholders.** **Best Friend**, **Front-Page Rumor** and **Guard Post** each roll once per playthrough. Your best friend's name is a placeholder, so they're someone new each time.
- **Lorebook.** **The Ashburn Almanac** dictionary holds the chocolate rule, the fan club and today's rumors.
worldOverview.introReadme:
💌 **It's Valentine's Day at Ashburn High, and you are the most popular student in school.**

The new rule says any chocolate you're handed must be eaten on the spot. The final bell rings in three minutes, and your fan club has planned this for weeks.

Pick who you are before the bell:
- **Reputation** (pick one) is why the whole school is after you. The **Star Athlete** has the most Stamina and gets it back fastest. The **Class Idol** leaves admirers too starstruck to grab you, but every sighting draws more of them. The **Student Council President** bluffs with the rules and slows the swarm down.
- **Constitution** (pick one) is how much chocolate you can survive. An **Iron Stomach** burns Sugar off fastest, a **Sweet Tooth** holds the most, and a **Dainty Appetite** fills up after a few pieces.
- **Bag Check** (take any) is what you brought today: **Running Shoes** for faster recovery, **Decoy Chocolates** to throw, and an **Annotated School Map** of every shortcut.

**All-Out Sprint** stays off at the start. You can switch it on whenever you need to run.

Each playthrough also rolls your best friend, this morning's front-page rumor, and where Coach Daizen stands guard.

openings.text: The final bell rings. I sling my bag over my shoulder and glance at the classroom door. Between me and it, a dozen classmates are already reaching into their desks for ribboned boxes.

The final bell is still ringing when the classroom door slides open. Hana Sakuragi stands in the doorway with a heart-shaped box the size of a pizza, and behind her the hallway is a wall of ribbon.

"Please don't run," she says, very politely. "You know the rule. Every piece, on the spot."

Around you, a dozen chairs scrape back at once.

The final bell rings, and I stay in my seat. Under the desk, I open the fan-club group chat my best friend forwarded me last week and scroll to the newest message, a map of the second floor with my name circled.

The last note of the bell fades, and the PA speaker above the chalkboard crackles.

"Good afternoon, Ashburn High! This is Kenta Ishida for the Broadcast Club, and it is Valentine's Day!" A cheer goes up in every classroom on the floor. "Our star is in Classroom 2-B. Fan club, take your positions. Let's have a clean, sporting chase!"

Every head in the room turns to you.

traits.name: Star Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Ace of the track team. Deeper stamina reserves and a quicker recovery.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the ace of the track team, famous for speed, with deep stamina reserves and fast recovery.

traits.name: Class Idol
traits.playerDescription: So adored that admirers hesitate to grab you. Every sighting draws more of them.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the class idol. Admirers are too love-struck to grab or tackle them outright, which opens escape windows. Every sighting draws more admirers, so the swarm keeps growing.

traits.name: Student Council President
traits.playerDescription: Respected, not only adored. You can bluff with the rules, and the swarm organizes more slowly.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the student council president. They quote school rules with authority to stall admirers and talk their way past staff. Classmates hesitate to mob someone they answer to.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: Sugar burns off you fast. Eat, wince and keep moving.
traits.aiDescription: The player has an iron stomach: sugar burns off quickly and rarely slows them for long.

traits.name: Sweet Tooth
traits.playerDescription: You can pack away far more chocolate before crashing. The problem: you kind of want to.
traits.aiDescription: The player has a sweet tooth. They can eat far more chocolate before a sugar crash, and they enjoy every piece, so "just one more" tempts them.

traits.name: Dainty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: A few chocolates is already a lot. The crash comes early, so every dodge matters.
traits.aiDescription: The player has a dainty appetite. Even a few chocolates push them toward a sugar crash, so every accepted box matters.

traits.name: Running Shoes
traits.playerDescription: You wore the good ones today. Stamina comes back quicker.
traits.aiDescription: The player is wearing proper running shoes: quick acceleration and fast stamina recovery.

traits.name: Decoy Chocolates
traits.playerDescription: A box of store-bought chocolates to throw, drop, or re-gift as a distraction.
traits.aiDescription: The player carries a box of store-bought decoy chocolates. Thrown or dropped, they scatter admirers who scramble for them; re-gifted, they can redirect an admirer's attention entirely.

traits.name: Annotated School Map
traits.playerDescription: A hand-drawn map of every shortcut, fire door, and blind spot in the building.
traits.aiDescription: The player carries a hand-annotated map of Ashburn High marking shortcuts, fire doors, and camera blind spots. They always know an alternate route between any two places in the school.

traits.name: All-Out Sprint
traits.playerDescription: Run flat out. You're much faster, but your Stamina drains each turn.
traits.aiDescription: The player is sprinting flat out: much harder to catch, vaulting obstacles and skipping pleasantries. It wears them out fast.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: How much running the player has left. Running, dodging and climbing spend it. Rest in a quiet spot restores it.

descriptors.description: Spent. Legs shaking, lungs burning; a brisk walk is the best on offer.
Tired. Breathing hard, and every staircase feels twice as long.
Winded. A little out of breath, still good for a sprint or two.
Fresh. Bouncing on the balls of their feet, ready to run.

stats.name: Sugar
stats.description: How much chocolate the player has eaten. Each chocolate eaten raises it, and it fades slowly on its own.

descriptors.description: Clear. Barely a taste of chocolate; light on their feet.
Sweet. A few chocolates down, a sugary taste that lingers.
Sugar high. Jittery hands, a racing heart and a heavy stomach.
Sugar crash. Queasy and slow; the next chocolate might be the last one they can take.

stats.name: Agility
stats.description: How quick the player is right now. It follows Stamina and Sugar.

descriptors.description: Leaden. Legs like wet cement; a determined walker could catch them.
Sluggish. Turns are wide and sprints are short.
Nimble. Quick enough to weave through a crowded hallway.
Untouchable. Full speed; nobody in this school can lay a ribbon on them.

He reads fan-club sightings live in a sports commentator's voice, and every hallway hears him. He loves a good story more than either side: a clever escape gets as much airtime as a capture, and a convincing false sighting goes straight on air.

entities.aiDescription: Sora Amagi, a quiet third-year who spends every Valentine's afternoon on the rooftop, away from the rule. She knows how the swarm searches and when the stairwell watch changes, and she trades that for company. She carries a box of homemade chocolate she lost her nerve to give, and she keeps who it is for to herself.

dictionaries.name: The Ashburn Almanac
dictionaries.description: School lore for the Valentine's chase: the rule, the fan club, the staff, and today's rumors.

entries.name: The Chocolate Rule
entries.value: Ashburn High's new Valentine's rule: a student eats any chocolate they are handed on the spot, in front of the giver. A refusal is a formal etiquette violation, and the whole school hears about it by the next period. The student council passed it, and the teachers enforce it with real enthusiasm.

entries.name: The Fan Club
entries.value: The player's fan club is unauthorized but better organized than most official clubs: a group chat with lookout rotations, corridor assignments, and a pinned map of the player's known routes. Hana Sakuragi runs it.

entries.name: Sugar Crash
entries.value: Each chocolate eaten raises Sugar. A little leaves a sweet taste; a lot brings jitters, a heavy stomach and slow legs. At the top, the player is queasy and can barely jog. Sugar fades with time and rest.

entries.name: Today's Guard Post
entries.value: Word in the hallways: Coach Daizen is watching {{ph:73dc2938-6e23-4688-beee-e2d7e3db8be2:world:e1e20b9b-df22-46d5-bd1c-5dca8375da3f}} today, whistle in hand, checking everyone who passes for undelivered chocolate obligations.

entries.name: The Rooftop
entries.value: The rooftop is off-limits, which is why it is quiet. Students who slip up there can catch their breath in peace. The only way down is the stairwell they came up, and the swarm watches it. Sora Amagi spends every Valentine's afternoon up here.

entries.name: This Morning's Paper
entries.value: This morning's school paper ran a front-page story claiming that {{ph:5f647181-2b29-4bba-8e15-415207ceeac9:world:ea3f212c-39e8-456c-969c-3b8dcba2c89e}}. Half the school believes it, and it has made the fan club significantly more motivated.

entries.name: Homemade Chocolate
entries.value: Homemade chocolate carries three times the social weight of store-bought. The giver watched tutorials, ruined a saucepan and started over twice. Eating it earns real gratitude. Dodging it wounds the giver, and their friends take it personally and pursue harder.

entries.name: The Broadcast Club
entries.value: The Broadcast Club runs the school PA. Today Kenta Ishida calls the chase live from the broadcast room: fan-club sightings, near misses and dramatic escapes, all in a sports commentator's voice. Every room and hallway hears where the player was last seen.
